pattern.description: The settled dashboard card begins a very slight shrink/drift as a whole (all tiles move together), the start of a reframe leading into the next beat during a narration pause.
pattern.why_premium: Keeping the hero UI subtly alive during a voice pause avoids a dead frame; an accelerating ease-in drift sets up the next move instead of cutting.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.dashboard', {scale: 0.99, x: -4, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}); whole card as one layer, no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 9], [1, 0.99], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); applied to the dashboard container. Ease, not spring.

notes: Motion is very small (camera scale 0.992, energy rising only at the very end of the burst) and the filmstrip frames look near-identical, so the exact change is uncertain; it may be the onset of a larger move in the next event. Candidate boxes b02-b20 are diff/OCR fragments of tiles moving with the card, not independent elements.
